sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored - GitHub
sources.snippet: Official Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M (~16.8 GB) + a harvested uncensored SYSTEM pack. GitHub cannot host the weights. Download the GGUF below, or pull the Ollama tag — this repo bakes the residual so ollama run stays uncensored.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}." For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.

sources.title: I Ran Qwen 3.8 27B on a Single RTX 5090. Here's What Actually Worked
sources.snippet: The short version: Qwen 3.8 27B is extremely usable on a single 5090, and native MTP matters a lot. My final uncensored setup runs a full 262,144-token context window and averages 132.89 tokens/sec in generation with MTP enabled.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B AEON Uncensored: How This Abliteration Actually Works
sources.snippet: A community abliteration of Qwen3.8-27B explains its KL-drift methodology, judge-based refusal testing, and how to run the model via vLLM.
